name: generate_questions
description: Return 1-3 multiple-choice questions generated strictly from the CEC rule provided by the user. Every question must have exactly 4 options, a correctAnswer index 0-3, an explanation that cites the ruleReference literally, and a ruleReference that matches the ruleNumber the user provided. If the rule is unworkable, return a single object whose question starts with 'SKIP:'.

question.description: The question stem. Complete sentence. 10-500 chars. May start with 'SKIP:' if the rule is unworkable.

options.description: Exactly 4 mutually-exclusive options, one correct, three plausible distractors.

correctAnswer.description: 0-indexed position of the correct option in the options array.

explanation.description: Must include the literal string 'Rule X-YYY' matching ruleReference. Quote/paraphrase the rule text and explain why the answer is correct.

ruleReference.description: Formatted as 'Rule X-YYY'. Must exactly match the ruleNumber provided by the user.

ruleComplexity.description: Your final assessment of the rule complexity.

tags.description: Lowercase tags. MUST include 'rule-X-YYY' (lowercase, no word 'rule').
